formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p19_t1_perturbed_basis_product_upper {n : Nat} (storedProduct correctionProduct : Fin n -> Real) : p19VecNorm2 (p19Add storedProduct correctionProduct) <= p19VecNorm2 storedProduct + p19VecNorm2 correctionProduct
formal_statement.plain_language: The Euclidean norm of the additively corrected basis product is at most the sum of the stored-product and correction norms.

informal_proof: Apply the finite-dimensional Euclidean triangle inequality to the stored product and its correction.
informal_statement: The exact upper half of the perturbation-norm bracket in equation (C.8).
